description: Inserts a second sound into the first while REMOVING the host region between time and endtime - excise + insert in one pass. Input 1 is the host, input 2 the replacement. Pinned to submode 1 (times in seconds); submodes 2/3 take sample / grouped-sample counts. Duration model 'indur1 - (endtime - time) + indur2' is SAMPLE-EXACT and - unlike insert/insil - the splice does NOT change the length (2 s host, replace [0.5,1.2] with 1 s -> 2.3000 / 101430 frames at -w0, -w15 and -w100 alike; 3 s host -> 3.3000). With -w0 the output is a verbatim sample-exact concatenation host[0:time] + insert + host[endtime:]. LANDMINE: endtime < time is silently ACCEPTED and the negative span EXTENDS the file (1.2/0.5 reversed -> 3.7000 s = indur1 + 0.7 + indur2, duplicating host material) - no swap, no warning, unlike every sibling editor. Both inputs must share channel count; stereo+stereo verified. Deterministic.
musical_use: Swap material in place: replace a fluffed word with a good take, substitute one drum hit for another, or transplant a different texture into the middle of a phrase - when the replacement's length differs from the removed region's, everything downstream shifts by exactly the difference (sample-exact, splice-independent), so grid arithmetic stays easy. level rides the newcomer's gain into the pocket without a separate pass. Replacing with a SHORTER sound tightens the phrase; with a LONGER one it stretches the form - both from one call. For insertion without removal use sfedit insert; for removal without insertion, sfedit excise.

time.description: Start of the replaced host region / landing time of the insert. Runtime-enforced 0 to the host duration. WARNING: no ordering check against endtime - see known_issues. Breakpoint file refused ('Cannot read parameter 1 [...]: brkpnt_files not permitted.'). Required.

endtime.description: End of the replaced host region. Runtime-enforced 0 to the host duration ('Parameter[2] Value (2.500000) out of range (0.000000 to 2.000000)'); values at the file end refused 'Overwrite endtime is beyond end of infile (allowing for splice)' (verbatim). endtime < time is silently accepted and EXTENDS the output (verified). Breakpoint file refused ('Cannot read parameter 2 [...]'). Required.

splice.description: Splice window in milliseconds at both joins (CDP internal default 15; enforced 0-5000). Unlike insert/insil, it does NOT change the output duration (verified 0/15/100 ms all 101430 frames). 0 = verbatim concatenation (sample-exact). Breakpoint file refused ('Cannot read parameter 3 [...]').

level.description: Gain multiplier on the inserted file (CDP default 1.0; enforced verbatim 'Parameter[4] Value (200.000000) out of range (0.000002 to 128.000000)'). Breakpoint file refused ('Cannot read parameter 4 [...]'). Scalar only.

examples.description: Replace 0.7 s of the host with a 1 s event.
examples.expected_use: Output = indur1 - 0.7 + indur2, sample-exact; 15 ms splices at both joins, duration splice-independent.
Bit-faithful host[0:0.5] + insert + host[1.2:] (verified allclose, max diff 0.0).

known_issues: REVERSED-BOUNDS LANDMINE (first-class): endtime < time is accepted with exit 0 and NO warning - the negative span EXTENDS the output (verified: '1.2 0.5' on a 2 s host + 1 s insert -> 3.7000 s, duplicating host material). Every sibling editor either swaps (cut, excise, zcut) or refuses; replace does neither. Validate ordering upstream.
endtime at/near the host's end is refused 'Overwrite endtime is beyond end of infile (allowing for splice)'.
The splice never changes the output duration here (verified) - divergent from insert/insil, where one splice length is consumed.
Both inputs must share channel count; stereo+stereo verified with identical arithmetic.
All four parameters reject breakpoint files ('Cannot read parameter N', N = 1-4). Deterministic (identical decoded shas 1.2 s apart).
